question: Where was the successful launch of Supersonic Missile Assisted Torpedo System developed by DRDO in December 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Orissa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DRDO successfully test-fired a long-range supersonic missile-assisted torpedo off the Balasore coast in Odisha in December 2021.**
 
• The system is **designed to enhance anti-submarine warfare capabilities** that are far beyond the range of conventional torpedoes.
 
• It is a** next-generation missile-based torpedo delivery system**.
 
• All the capabilities of the missile were successfully demonstrated during the test.
 
• Various technologies have been developed by several DRDO laboratories for this advanced missile system.
